plugins.name: gauge
plugins.description: Context, cost and rate limits in the footer, warnings at thresholds you set, a compact helper, and /gauge for per-turn figures, the context breakdown and spend history.

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: Ask Claude for advice in a side pane without touching the session's context: any model, optional read-only tools, an ongoing side thread, cache-aware cost warnings, and a hand-off when an answer is worth keeping.
